description: Return the natural logarithm (base #e) of the <dataType> value, as ECMAScript Math.log does. log(0.0) is -Infinity; a negative value is an error. A result that would be NaN, or a NaN argument, is an error. An integer is not accepted: write to_double(v).

errorsThrown.reason: the result would be NaN, or an operand is NaN
